src: de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Handel — «die Händel» is the plural of sense [3] (a quarrel); the trade sense is {{K|nur Singular}}. The gate copies the page's table and cannot be told which sense a card means.

de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Zeug — «die Zeuge» is the plural of the technical senses (fabrics, gear); the card is the mass noun «stuff», which has none. Left as it was, «Der vermeintliche Zeuge» resolved to this card instead of der Zeuge.
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Halt attests both; one is stated because «Halte» is also the imperative of halten, and four example sentences opening «Halte …» resolved to this noun.
